text:
jordan: Heads-up — request from Infra for a RBAC change on the BYOK HSM proxy. They want a new "signer-only" operator role (can call Sign/Verify) but not Unwrap/Export. Can we sketch custody/audit implications?
sarah: Quick take: signer-only reduces blast radius if an operator is compromised, but we need to ensure logs prove the key material never left HSM and no wrap calls occurred. Also update attestation records.
mike: infra context — customer TLS and code-signing flows need signing capability without unwrapping. We can add a controller role that only mounts keys for sign session. Is there a recommended policy snippet?
sarah: We should require dual-approval for role grant (two admins) and time-limited leases. Audit should include: caller identity, invoked operation, HSM slot/session id, and attestation blob.
elaine: Ops note — current keystore proxy forwards raw KMIP/PKCS#11 commands. We can filter at proxy layer to reject Unwrap/Export, but we must also enforce HSM-level policy (so a compromised proxy can't bypass).
jordan: Good point. Who owns updating attestation? Should we surface attestation to the customer during onboarding?
sarah: Security owns attestation schema; infra can implement endpoints. We should add an audit field: attestation:base64, attestation_verifier:sha256, and record firmware version.
nanaction: sec-bot: Automated check — existing keys with legacy operator-entitlement need migration. Found 14 keys with operator role that allows unwrap. Recommend migration window 30d. :rotating_light:
mike: Can we do a rolling migration where we create signer-only key wrapping keys and rekey customer keys under new policy? Concern: rewrap requires Unwrap rights on old key. That defeats the purpose unless we use HSM internal rekey operation.
sarah: If HSM supports rewrap-within-device (key rewrap opaque) do it inside HSM so private key never exposed. If not, require customer consent and legal sign-off.
nanaction: jordan: legal sign-off requested for customers in EEA banking vertical — tagging @ana (legal)
ana (legal): For EEA bank customers we need documented proof of non-export (attestation+FW hash) and a data-processing addendum update. Also need revocation SLA clauses for operator compromise.
elaine: For incident playbook: if an operator key is suspected exfiltrated, steps: 1) revoke operator entitlement 2) freeze new sign sessions 3) generate attestation dump for affected keys 4) notify customers per SLA 5) initiate forensics. Do we need to add a runbook change?
sarah: Yes — add a new IR runbook page that includes KMS/HSM-specific evidence (attestation blob, HSM audit logs, operator auth token sessions). Also ensure logs go to immutable bucket for 90+ days for audits.
mike: Implementation detail — audit streaming currently sent to splunk with 30d retention. Security wants 90d immutable retention for any BYOK keys. Ops: we'll add a write-once S3 bucket + lock, forward duplicate stream. Estimated infra work ~2w.
jordan: Can someone draft the RBAC delta JSON for infra to apply? Suggested fields: {"role":"signer_only","allowed_ops":["Sign","Verify"],"deny_ops":["Unwrap","Export","Wrap"],"approval":2,"ttl_s":86400} — placeholder.
sarah: That looks fine. Add "attestation_required": "true" and "fw_whitelist": ["3.2.1","3.2.2"]. Also ensure role cannot be assigned to non-human principals (no service accounts without 2FA).
mike: I'll take the JSON and open a PR against keystore-proxy. Will add proxy-level reject rules and an HSM-policy push for supported HSM models.
sec-bot: Vulnerability note — CVE-2026-0451 affects firmware 3.2.0 signing path; any keys on 3.2.0 should be blocked from production signing until patched. Detected 3 keys on 3.2.0.
sarah: Triage: mark impacted keys, notify customers, apply temporary routing to signer-fallback cluster that uses a different firmware or offline attestation, and schedule emergency rotation if patch not available within 48h.
elaine: Ops checklist for emergency rotation: coordinate change window, update customer SLA notices, run attestation before/after rotation, verify no unwrap operations were attempted.
jordan: Follow-ups: 1) Mike to PR RBAC delta + proxy filters (ETA 2w) 2) Sarah to update IR runbook and attestation schema (ETA 1w) 3) Ana to draft customer wording for EEA and banking (ETA 3d) 4) Elaine to set up WORM bucket and 90d forward (ETA 2w).
nanaction: sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-4127 for RBAC change migration and SEC-4128 for audit retention; pinging owners. :white_check_mark:
